title: Disentangling the Effect of Letter Frequency, Bigram Frequency and Inter-item Similarity in Recognition Memory: A Global Matching Model Approach
venue: PsyArXiv preprint (version 2, 24 August 2026; listed as in press at Journal of Experimental Psychology: Learning, Memory, and Cognition on the second author's publication page)
caption_short: Schematic of one study-test cycle: 40 words for 1 s each, a 45 s arithmetic distractor, then 80 test words (40 studied, 40 new) judged old or new at the participant's own pace; ten cycles per participant.
notes: Drawn by us: the preprint has no procedure figure (its Figure 1 shows letter and bigram frequency distributions; the other figures show results, model fits and item analyses). Procedure from the Methods of preprint v2 (pp. 18-19: ten study-test cycles, 40 study words, 80 test probes, 1 s per word with 150 ms gaps, 45 s maths distractor, self-paced 1 / 0 key responses, words in upper case). Experiment 3b, the file used here with 85 participants, is described as Experiment 3 in preprint v1 (May 2025, 85 recruited) and as a pilot study reported in Supplementary Material C in v2; its design and procedure are the same as Experiments 1 and 2. The preprint carries no licence on PsyArXiv. Example words are illustrative. Rendered with Pillow (scripts/schem_words.py).
